study_title: Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene Determinants of Childhood Diarrhoea and Under-Five Mortality in Ghana: A 261-District Spatial Machine-Learning Mediation Analysis
affiliations: Cocoa Clinic, Ghana COCOBOD, Accra, Ghana
geographic_scope: Ghana 261 health districts (260 mapped + Guan tabular)
primary_outcome: Under-five mortality rate (U5MR per 1,000 live births)
top_finding_1: 25 LISA HH hotspots in northern Ghana; 35 LL coldspots in south
top_finding_2: ~36% of improved-water → U5MR effect mediated through diarrhoea (NIE -0.12, NDE -0.21, total -0.32, E-value 1.11)
target_journal: International Journal of Environmental Research and Public Health (IJERPH)
